description: Morphe Patches 1.12.0. Includes two independently selectable Suno patches: timestamped-lyrics export (LRC, enhanced LRC, SRT, WebVTT, JSON) and app cloning/branding with configurable package name, app name, and custom icon; the Opera GX 56-icon launcher selector; the independently selectable Opera GX raw mod downloader; and the Chrome 150 MonkeyScript manager with contrast-safe Material You, page-capable userscript execution, Greasy Fork/Sleazy Fork installation, and publishing.
